name: bg-compact
description: Adds server-side context editing (clear_tool_uses_20250919) to every engine Messages request, merged into any edit and beta header already there.

triggerTokens.title: Trigger tokens
triggerTokens.description: Input tokens at which the API starts clearing old tool results. An integer of at least 1.

keepToolUses.title: Kept tool uses
keepToolUses.description: Most recent tool use/result pairs the API keeps whole. An integer of at least 0.

clearAtLeastTokens.title: Clear at least
clearAtLeastTokens.description: Input tokens a clear must free, or the API skips it and the prompt cache stays intact. An integer of at least 0; 0 sends no minimum.
